data <- read.csv("/Users/devyn/Downloads/listening-fatigue-research/Data/FatigueDdata.csv")

check_columns <- function(data, pattern) {
  cols        <- grep(pattern, names(data), value = TRUE)
  non_numeric <- sapply(data[cols], function(x) !is.numeric(x))
  if (any(non_numeric)) {
    for (col in cols[non_numeric])
      data[[col]] <- as.numeric(as.character(data[[col]]))
  }
  data
}

data_clean <- check_columns(data_clean, "^vfs10_")
data_clean <- check_columns(data_clean, "^fat")
data_clean <- check_columns(data_clean, "^comm")


# 2. OUTCOME SCORES


safe_row_sum <- function(df) {
  m         <- as.matrix(df)
  n_nonmiss <- rowSums(!is.na(m))
  s         <- rowSums(m, na.rm = TRUE)
  s[n_nonmiss == 0] <- NA
  s
}

data_clean <- data_clean %>%
  mutate(
    vfs_total     = safe_row_sum(select(., starts_with("vfs10_"))),
    fatigue_total = safe_row_sum(
      select(., starts_with("fat")) %>%
        select(-matches("fatimp"), -matches("fatexp26"))
    ),
    comm_total    = safe_row_sum(
      select(., starts_with("comm")) %>%
        select(-matches("comm_complete"))
    )
  )

cat("\nSummary of outcome variables:\n")
print(summary(data_clean[, c("vfs_total", "fatigue_total", "comm_total")]))


# 3. LANGUAGE COMPOSITES & RELIABILITY


create_composite_with_alpha <- function(data, vars, name) {
  existing_vars <- vars[vars %in% names(data)]
  missing_vars  <- setdiff(vars, existing_vars)
  if (length(missing_vars) > 0)
    cat("Warning: Missing vars for", name, ":", paste(missing_vars, collapse = ", "), "\n")
  if (length(existing_vars) < 2) {
    cat("Error: Need ≥2 variables for", name, "\n")
    return(list(composite = rep(NA_real_, nrow(data)), alpha = NA_real_))
  }
  subset_data  <- data[, existing_vars, drop = FALSE]
  alpha_result <- psych::alpha(subset_data, check.keys = TRUE)
  composite    <- rowMeans(subset_data, na.rm = TRUE)
  composite[is.nan(composite)] <- NA
  cat("Cronbach's alpha for", name, ":", round(alpha_result$total$std.alpha, 3), "\n")
  list(composite = composite, alpha = alpha_result$total$std.alpha)
}

p_matrix <- matrix(NA, nrow = ncol(cor_data), ncol = ncol(cor_data))
rownames(p_matrix) <- colnames(p_matrix) <- colnames(cor_data)
for (i in seq_len(ncol(cor_data)))
  for (j in seq_len(ncol(cor_data)))
    p_matrix[i, j] <- if (i != j)
      cor.test(cor_data[, i], cor_data[, j])$p.value else 0

p_long   <- melt(p_m_ord,   varnames = c("Var1", "Var2"), value.name = "P_Value")

cor_p <- merge(cor_long, p_long, by = c("Var1", "Var2")) %>%

# 9. FIT ALL MODELS

fit_model <- function(dat, dv, predictors) {
  vars <- unique(c(dv, predictors))
  vars <- vars[vars %in% names(dat)]
  lm(as.formula(paste(dv, "~ .")), data = dat[, vars])
}

# Model 3: primary (on Table 2 dataset)

  lapply(outcomes, function(dv) fit_model(analysis_table2, dv, predictors_m3)),
  outcome_labels
)

    }, error = function(e) cat("VIF error:", e$message, "\n"))
  }
}


# 11. CELL FORMATTING — STANDARDIZED β

# standardize_lm: z-scores DV + numeric predictors, refits model.
# Factors untouched → their β = group diff in SD units of DV
# (partially standardized; standard practice for mixed models).
# t-stats and p-values are invariant to this transformation.


standardize_lm <- function(m) {
  mf <- model.frame(m)
  dv <- names(mf)[1]
  Xn <- names(mf)[-1]
  mf[[dv]] <- as.numeric(scale(mf[[dv]]))
  for (v in Xn)
    if (is.numeric(mf[[v]])) mf[[v]] <- as.numeric(scale(mf[[v]]))
  lm(formula(m), data = mf)
}

fmt_p <- function(p) {
  if (is.na(p)) return("")
  if (p < .001) return("< .001")
  paste0("= ", sub("^0", "", sprintf("%.3f", p)))
}

fmt_cell <- function(model, term) {
  s <- summary(model)$coefficients
  if (!term %in% rownames(s)) return("\u2014")
  B <- s[term, "Estimate"]
  SE <- s[term, "Std. Error"]
  p <- s[term, "Pr(>|t|)"]
  paste0(sprintf("%.2f", B), " (", sprintf("%.2f", SE), ")")
}

fmt_r2 <- function(model) {
  s <- summary(model)
  sprintf("R\u00B2 = %.3f, adj. R\u00B2 = %.3f", s$r.squared, s$adj.r.squared)
}

fmt_f <- function(model) {
  fs   <- summary(model)$fstatistic
  Fval <- as.numeric(fs[1])
  df1  <- as.numeric(fs[2])
  df2  <- as.numeric(fs[3])
  pval <- pf(Fval, df1, df2, lower.tail = FALSE)
  p_fmt <- if (pval < .001) "< .001"
           else sprintf("= %s", sub("^0", "", sprintf("%.3f", pval)))
  sprintf("F(%d, %d) = %.2f, p %s", df1, df2, Fval, p_fmt)
}


fmt_cell_full <- function(model, term) {
  s_raw <- summary(model)$coefficients
  if (!term %in% rownames(s_raw)) return("\u2014")

  B   <- s_raw[term, "Estimate"]
  SE  <- s_raw[term, "Std. Error"]
  p   <- s_raw[term, "Pr(>|t|)"]
  ci  <- tryCatch(confint(model)[term, ], error = function(e) c(NA_real_, NA_real_))

  m_std <- standardize_lm(model)
  s_std <- summary(m_std)$coefficients
  beta  <- if (term %in% rownames(s_std)) s_std[term, "Estimate"] else NA_real_

  paste0(
    "B = ",    sprintf("%.2f", B),
    " [",      sprintf("%.2f", ci[1]), ", ", sprintf("%.2f", ci[2]), "]",
    ", \u03B2 = ", sprintf("%.2f", beta),
    ", SE = ", sprintf("%.2f", SE),
    ", p ",    fmt_p(p)
  )
}

# APPENDIX TABLE BUILDER

build_appendix_table <- function(model_list, model_label, all_terms_named) {
  tibble(Predictor = names(all_terms_named)) %>%
    mutate(
      `Listening Fatigue`    = map_chr(all_terms_named,
                                       ~ fmt_cell_full(model_list[["Listening Fatigue"]], .x)),
      `General Fatigue`      = map_chr(all_terms_named,
                                       ~ fmt_cell_full(model_list[["General Fatigue"]], .x)),
      `Communication Health` = map_chr(all_terms_named,
                                       ~ fmt_cell_full(model_list[["Communication Health"]], .x))
    ) %>%
    bind_rows(
      tibble(Predictor          = "Model R\u00B2",
             `Listening Fatigue`    = fmt_r2(model_list[["Listening Fatigue"]]),
             `General Fatigue`      = fmt_r2(model_list[["General Fatigue"]]),
             `Communication Health` = fmt_r2(model_list[["Communication Health"]])),
      tibble(Predictor          = "F-test",
             `Listening Fatigue`    = fmt_f(model_list[["Listening Fatigue"]]),
             `General Fatigue`      = fmt_f(model_list[["General Fatigue"]]),
             `Communication Health` = fmt_f(model_list[["Communication Health"]])),
      tibble(Predictor          = "N",
             `Listening Fatigue`    = as.character(nobs(model_list[["Listening Fatigue"]])),
             `General Fatigue`      = as.character(nobs(model_list[["General Fatigue"]])),
             `Communication Health` = as.character(nobs(model_list[["Communication Health"]])))
    ) %>%
    mutate(Model = model_label, .before = 1)
}

  "Lipreading (sometimes vs. never/rarely)"           = "lipreading_groupedsometimes",

)

out_cols <- c("Listening Fatigue", "General Fatigue", "Communication Health")

table2_df <- tibble(Predictor = names(table2_terms)) %>%
  mutate(
    `Listening Fatigue`    = map_chr(table2_terms, ~ fmt_cell(models_m3[["Listening Fatigue"]], .x)),
    `General Fatigue`      = map_chr(table2_terms, ~ fmt_cell(models_m3[["General Fatigue"]], .x)),

           `General Fatigue`      = fmt_r2(models_m3[["General Fatigue"]]),

           `Listening Fatigue`    = fmt_f(models_m3[["Listening Fatigue"]]),
           `General Fatigue`      = fmt_f(models_m3[["General Fatigue"]]),
           `Communication Health` = fmt_f(models_m3[["Communication Health"]])),
    tibble(Predictor = "N",
           `Listening Fatigue`    = as.character(nobs(models_m3[["Listening Fatigue"]])),
           `General Fatigue`      = as.character(nobs(models_m3[["General Fatigue"]])),
           `Communication Health` = as.character(nobs(models_m3[["Communication Health"]])))
  )

cat("\n\nTable 2.\nPrimary regression results (Model 3): Associations between language proficiency, language usage, and outcomes\n\n")

kable(table2_df, format = "html", escape = TRUE,
      col.names = c("", out_cols), align = c("l", "l", "l", "l")) %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE, position = "left") %>%
  row_spec(4, extra_css = "border-bottom: 2px solid black;") %>%
  row_spec((nrow(table2_df) - 2):nrow(table2_df), bold = TRUE) %>%
  print()

write.csv(table2_df, "Table2_Model3_Primary.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# 14. MODEL FIT SUMMARY (ALL 9 MODELS)

get_fit <- function(m, label_model, label_outcome) {
  s <- summary(m)
  f <- s$fstatistic
  p <- pf(f[1], f[2], f[3], lower.tail = FALSE)
  tibble(
    Model   = label_model,
    Outcome = label_outcome,
    R2      = round(s$r.squared, 3),
    AdjR2   = round(s$adj.r.squared, 3),
    F_stat  = round(as.numeric(f[1]), 2),
    p_value = ifelse(p < .001, "< .001",
                     sub("^0", "", sprintf("%.3f", p))),
    N       = nobs(m)
  )
}

fit_summary <- bind_rows(
  map_dfr(outcome_labels, ~ get_fit(models_m1[[.x]], "Model 1 (Proficiency Dominance)", .x)),
  map_dfr(outcome_labels, ~ get_fit(models_m2[[.x]], "Model 2 (Usage Dominance)",       .x)),
  map_dfr(outcome_labels, ~ get_fit(models_m3[[.x]], "Model 3 (Primary, 4 Lang IVs)", .x))
)

cat("\nMODEL FIT SUMMARY \n")
print(fit_summary)
write.csv(fit_summary, "model_fit_summary.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# 15. RELIABILITY TABLE

cat("\nRELIABILITY SUMMARY: \n")
alpha_values %>%
  mutate(
    Cronbach_Alpha = round(Cronbach_Alpha, 3),
    Reliability    = case_when(
      Cronbach_Alpha >= 0.9 ~ "Excellent",
      Cronbach_Alpha >= 0.8 ~ "Good",
      Cronbach_Alpha >= 0.7 ~ "Acceptable",
      Cronbach_Alpha >= 0.6 ~ "Questionable",
      TRUE                  ~ "Poor"
    )
  ) %>%
  kable(format = "markdown",
        caption = "Internal Consistency Reliability of Composite Variables") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed")) %>%
  print()
